reason: This repository is a DSH web plugin centered on a Settings-side panel for Agent Skill administration, matching a navigation and management interface purpose. It is primarily a UI tool for consolidating skill visibility, search, notes, enable/disable/import/delete actions, usage statistics, and local trigger matching, with local host APIs and local files for state and logs.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，在“设置 → Skill Cockpit”面板集中管理系统、项目和技能池中的 Agent Skill，支持搜索、启用/停用、删除、导入、备注、使用统计与本地测试触发预检。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web plugin that provides a Skill Cockpit panel in Settings to manage Agent Skills across system, project, and pool scopes with search, enable/disable, delete, import, notes, usage stats, and local test-fire matching.

capabilities: Local web UI for browsing and managing skills in one panel
Search and note management for skill discovery
Enable/disable, delete, and import operations on skill scopes
Reading/writing local skill metadata files for notes and usage statistics
Local lexical test-fire scoring for candidate skill triggers
Host-side HTTP API endpoints for state, mutation, and listing actions

reasons.code: Skill Cockpit is a Settings panel UI that exposes skill viewing and management operations.
The plugin defines local data files for notes, stats, and audit logging, indicating filesystem side effects.
Delete/import flows are bounded by scope and include guards/conflict preview, but still affect local skill files.
Mutating and query APIs are listed for enable, disable, note, delete, import, state, and test-fire operations.
Plugin metadata targets the DSH web platform and web client/runtime integration.
